name: Bvlgari Shanghai
positioning: Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai, a tower and restored 1916 building on the Suhe Creek waterfront, minutes from the Bund
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led city hotel near the Bund
Guests who care about Italian dining and a spa with an indoor pool

facts.text: The hotel is on the Suhe Creek waterfront and forms part of the SUHE CREEK project, a riverside urban revitalization.
The property combines a 48-storey tower with the restored former Chamber of Commerce Shanghai building dating from 1916.
The hotel is on the banks of Suzhou Creek, just minutes from the Bund.
Il Ristorante - Niko Romito is on the 47th floor of the hotel.
The Bvlgari Bar shares the 47th floor with Il Ristorante - Niko Romito.
Bao Li Xuan is the hotel's Chinese restaurant specializing in Guangdong cuisine.
The Bvlgari Spa uses La Mer products and offers rituals inspired by traditional Chinese medicine.
La Terrazza has teak decking, ivory-cushioned armchairs and curtained cabanas.
Condé Nast Traveler names Antonio Citterio and Patricia Viel as behind the Bulgari-hotel aesthetic.
The hotel has an Italian garden, Il Giardino, in front of the Lounge, available for private parties and events.

highlights.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito was awarded one Michelin star by The Michelin Guide Shanghai for 6 consecutive years since 2019.
The Bvlgari Bar's oval counter in Shanghai is made from hand-hammered bronze topped with mirrored steel.
The centrepiece of the spa is an indoor heated swimming pool surrounded by columns recalling a Roman bath.
At sunset hours, every drink ordered at The Bvlgari Bar is paired with fresh canapes, at the oval bar or on the outdoor terrace.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes that, because of the building's shape and orientation, a few rooms have disappointing views, and advises asking for a room with a view across the Huangpu River to Pudong.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive brand positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited availability due to the boutique size of the hotel.
